messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@primewave.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <procurement@primewave.io>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor activation kickoff / DPA and SOC2 request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're starting vendor intake for PrimeWave's integration and procurement needs a go-live target of mid-December. Procurement asked me to collect the standard security and privacy artifacts so our legal and infosec teams can sign off. Can you send over 

- Your DPA (redlineable format if possible)
- The latest SOC 2 report (redacted OK) or a secure download link
- Current subprocessor roster with locations
- PO routing instructions and any preferred PO template/fields (we need billing contact and remit address)

Also flag any onboarding steps that typically block activation (e.g., e-signature, finance terms, network allowlist window). I attached our PO template for reference.

Appreciate it — if you can send by tomorrow that keeps us on schedule.

Best,
Alex
Sr. Procurement Lead
PrimeWave

Attachment: PrimeWave_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor activation kickoff / DPA and SOC2 request

Alex — thanks for the clear list and the PO template. Attaching the core artifacts below and outlining next steps so your team can route internally.

Attachments enclosed: Redwood_DPA_v3.1.pdf, SOC2_Report_Jun2026.pdf, subprocessors_list.csv
SOC 2: hosted secure download link included in the attached PDF (section 2) — if you prefer an access-controlled portal, we can grant temporary access to your security reviewer.
DPA: we normally execute our standard DPA via DocuSign; redlines are accepted but need Legal review (tagging Karthik).
Subprocessors: CSV includes service, location (region), and purpose. We call out third-party hosting and analytics vendors.

PO routing: please send the signed PO to accounts-payable@redwood.com and cc marissa.cole@redwood.com. Standard terms: Net30. Remit address and tax details are in the PO template you provided. If PrimeWave requires a different billing contact or AP portal, let me know and we can accommodate.

Onboarding blockers: 
- Signed DPA (DocuSign is fastest)
- PO received and processed by finance
- Optional allowlist step for IPs (1 business day once we have IP list)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Your legal to review DPA and indicate any non-starter clauses by EOD Wednesday.
2) Procurement to submit the PO (we can provision staging access once PO is in finance's queue).
3) We'll schedule a short handoff call with our onboarding ops once the DPA is executed.

Link to our mutual action plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MutualActionPlan (I've added a starter checklist).

Karthik — tagging you for DPA redline process and any special counsel notes. Ben — FYI on PO routing.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <procurement@primewave.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@primewave.io>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor activation kickoff / DPA and SOC2 request

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments. A couple follow-ups from our side after an initial review: 

1) Data residency: can you confirm whether any subprocessors store customer content in the EU? Our policy requires EU residency for certain customer classes. We saw several EU-region entries in the CSV; need explicit confirmation which subprocessors (if any) may process PrimeWave customer content.

2) Retention & logging: we require 365 days of audit-log retention for admin/log events as a procurement condition — does Redwood maintain that by default or is that an add-on?

3) DPA redlines: I attached the specific clause our legal flags (section 5.2, data deletion timeline). We prefer 30 days for data deletion after termination; your DPA shows 60. Will Redwood accept 30? If not, what is the escalation path?

4) PO: attaching our completed template. Please confirm the billing contact and the remit address you provided earlier match our AP fields before we submit.

If we can resolve these by EOD Wednesday we can proceed with PO and provisioning.

Thanks — Samantha
Procurement Manager
PrimeWave

Attachment: PW_PO_Completed.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <procurement@primewave.io>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@primewave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor activation kickoff / DPA and SOC2 request

Samantha — great questions, answered inline below. Quoted your note for context.

> 1) Data residency: can you confirm whether any subprocessors store customer content in the EU?
We reviewed the subprocessors_list.csv. Two analytics vendors have EU-based processing nodes; however, customer content is not routed to analytics processors by default — only aggregated telemetry (pseudonymized) is sent. We can provide a scoped subprocessor attestation that shows processing purpose and whether customer content is stored. If you require EU-only storage for customer content, we can recommend self-hosted/private options (Redwood Private) or sign a committed EU-only subprocessors clause (needs legal signoff).

> 2) Retention & logging: we require 365 days of audit-log retention for admin/log events as a procurement condition — does Redwood maintain that by default or is that an add-on?
Our default platform retention for admin/audit logs is 180 days. We offer an extended retention add-on (365/730 days) which is commonly purchased for regulated accounts. Adding 365-day retention is a one-time config + nominal recurring fee; I'll have finance send a quote when you confirm.

> 3) DPA redlines: section 5.2, data deletion timeline (you prefer 30 days vs our 60) — will Redwood accept 30?
Karthik, can you review the attached redline and confirm whether Legal can accept 30-day deletion for this account or propose a counter (we typically hold 60 to support incident response).

> 4) PO: please confirm the billing contact and the remit address you provided earlier match our AP fields before we submit.
Confirmed. Please send the signed PO to accounts-payable@redwood.com and cc marissa.cole@redwood.com. Remit address: Redwood Inference, 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94102. Tax/EIN details are in the PrimeWave_PO_Template.pdf you provided; let me know if you need a PDF from our finance team.

Next steps: 
- Karthik to review DPA redline (he's cc'ed) and provide a response by EOD Wednesday.
- If DPA redline is acceptable, Alex/Samantha to submit PO. Once PO is in finance queue, we can open staging access (api keys restricted) within 24 hours and schedule the onboarding call.

DocuSign link for standard DPA: https://app.docusign.com/frames/startlanding?envelopeId=12345-Redwood-DPA

Thanks — I'll follow up after Karthik confirms the clause.

Best,
Marissa
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
